sockets.Socket_Head: the head centre when equipped (the visor hinge point)
sockets.Socket_Lamp: a helmet lamp mount above the brow

states.stored: helmet on its base, visor open (the GLB rest pose)
states.equipped: carried by the suit's Head bone (equip_bone), so the face stays inside the shell in every clip: its base centre at equip_origin_m in the rest pose (character space, Godot axes) with scale; a ponytail is tucked (tuck_bones scaled down)
states.visor: rotate the Visor child about +X by visor_closed_rotation_deg_x times the closed fraction

fit: Measured on the installed CH_<Name>_EVA suits by production/tools/fit_helmets_eva.py: the smallest scale (never below 1.0) leaving 2 cm round the head and hair, 1.5 cm over the crown and an opening 1 cm wider than the suit's neck ring; the base sits 2 cm down over the ring and the shell is centred on the head. A ponytail (its own bones) is tucked while the helmet is on.
